title: Callisia Repens 'Kribo' - 1x Mini Plug - Turtle Vine Inchplant - Easy Care Plant
description:
Add an eye-catching twist to your collection with this mini plug of Callisia repens ‘Kribo’. This tiny, creeping houseplant has pointed-oval, succulent leaves that uniquely shift in color: new growth often stains pink at different stages of development, later maturing to deeper green. Some stems may look mostly green at times, but they are not permanently reverted—given the right conditions, the pink tones can return. Perfect for small pots, shelves, terrariums, or mixed planters.


 What you’ll receive:


  Quantity: 1x mini plug plant
 

  Size: Young rooted plug (approx. 2–4 cm plant top; plug cell 2–3 cm)
 

  Supplied in: Grower’s plug (not a decorative pot)
 

  Plant type: Callisia repens ‘Kribo’ (live plant)
 

 Plant features:


  Compact, creeping/trailing habit
 

  Pointed-oval, succulent leaves with pink staining that can come and go
 

  Fast to establish; great for small trailing displays
 

  Beginner-friendly and collectible
 

 Care guide:


  Light: Bright, indirect light enhances pink coloration; avoid harsh midday sun.
 

  Water: Keep lightly moist; allow the top 1–2 cm to dry between waterings. Do not waterlog.
 

  Humidity: Average home humidity (40–60%) is fine.
 

  Temperature: 15–26°C; protect from drafts and frost.
 

  Soil: Well-draining houseplant mix with added perlite.
 

  Feed: Half-strength balanced fertilizer every 4–6 weeks in spring–summer.
 

 Growth and appearance:


  Color cycling is normal: pink blush on newer growth, deepening to green with age.
 

  Stems that appear green are not “reverted” permanently; pink can reappear with good light.
 

  Pinch or trim to encourage a fuller, bushier mat.
 

 Shipping and packaging:


  Carefully packed to protect the plug in transit.
 

  Shipped in its grow plug with minimal media to reduce mess.
 

  Minor cosmetic wear in transit is possible; plant rebounds with proper care.
 

 Important notes:


  Live plant: No returns on perishables; contact us within 48 hours of delivery with clear photos if there are any issues.
 

  Not for consumption. Keep out of reach of pets and children.
 

 Naming and background:


  Common names: Turtle vine, Bolivian wandering dude, creeping inchplant.
 

  Family: Commelinaceae. Callisia is a cousin to Tradescantia.
 

 Ideal for:


  Windowsills, shelves, desktops
 

  Small hanging planters and trailing accents
 

  Terrariums and mixed planters
 

  Plant gifts and starter collections
